I'm a **postdoctoral researcher** at the Bioinformatics Research Center, North Carolina State University. I study viruses, bacteria and plasmids in environmental microbial communities, using metagenomics to understand how microbes respond to a changing climate.

I build reproducible bioinformatics pipelines and teach others to do the same as a **Nextflow Ambassador**.
